notes.title: The Holyburn Witches is now 100% free
notes.content:
We've heard all the great feedback from our valued users and are glad to announce the below updates to the game:

[list]
[*] Added more lore to create a deeper world.
[*] Removed the annoying gameplay of getting lost in the woods.  It's much easier to navigate the map now.
[*] Improved the sound design to make it creepier.
[*] Better overall difficulty level.
[*] The game is now completely free.
[/list]

Keep the feedback coming, we really appreciate it!
